settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Your clinic, your team's logins and your own account — all in one place.
settings.desc_clinic: Name in Arabic and English, specialty, contact details, address and time zone.
settings.desc_portal: Your public address for online booking and the staff sign-in entry.
settings.desc_payments: Card payments before confirming online consultations (PayTabs or HyperPay), and refunds.
settings.desc_booking_links: Website booking button, tracked links, QR code and the DocBook clinic directory.
settings.desc_team: Logins for doctors, nurses, reception and accounting — invite, reset passwords, disable.
settings.desc_roles: What each role can see and do, plus your own custom roles.
settings.desc_insurance: Insurance companies you accept and their coverage.
settings.desc_medications: The list doctors pick from when writing prescriptions.
settings.desc_diagnosis_codes: ICD-10 search and your clinic's own diagnosis codes.
settings.desc_security: Change your password and sign out other devices.
settings.desc_appearance: Light or dark theme, and the clinic's colour and logo.
settings.desc_data: Who did what and when, a full Excel export, and deleting the clinic.
settings.clinic_lead: This information appears on your clinic page, on invoices and on prescriptions.
settings.sec_identity_sub: How patients see your clinic, in Arabic and English.
settings.sec_contact_sub: Shown on your clinic page so patients can call, message or find you.
settings.sec_region_sub: Time zone decides "today" for appointments; currency is used for fees and invoices.
settings.f_about_ph: A few sentences about your clinic, services and team.
settings.f_map_help: Open your clinic on Google Maps, tap Share and paste the link (must start with https://).
settings.f_tz_help: Appointment times and "today" follow this time zone.
settings.f_currency_help: Used for fees, invoices and reports.
settings.f_currency_warn: You already have invoices. Changing the currency does not convert existing amounts.
settings.portal_lead: Patients book online at your clinic's own address, and your staff sign in from the same page.
settings.portal_address_sub: Share this link on social media, Google Maps and WhatsApp.
settings.portal_change_warn: If you change the address, the old link stops working — update it wherever you shared it.
settings.booking_sub: When on, patients can pick a doctor, a service and a free time on your clinic page.
settings.booking_on_text: Patients can book online. New online bookings appear in Appointments and notify the front desk.
settings.booking_off_text: Your clinic page still shows your details, but patients can't book online.
settings.booking_off_confirm: Patients will no longer be able to book online. Existing appointments are not affected.
settings.staff_entry_title: Staff sign-in from the clinic page
settings.staff_entry_sub: Everyone on your team can also sign in from your clinic page.
settings.staff_entry_1_noslug: Set the clinic page address above first.
settings.staff_entry_3_text: With the e-mail and password from Staff & logins. Each role lands on its own start page (doctor → my day, reception & nurses → front desk, accountant → billing).
settings.appearance_lead: Your own display preferences, plus the clinic's colour and logo used across DocBook and on printouts.
settings.appearance_lead_personal: Choose how DocBook looks for you.
settings.theme_dark_text: Easier on the eyes at night.
settings.language_help: Used for the interface and for e-mails sent to you.
settings.brand_sub: Buttons, links and highlights for everyone in this clinic, and your clinic page.
settings.brand_color_help: Pick a colour or type a hex code such as #1d4ed8. Leave empty for the DocBook default.
settings.cal_mode_help: How appointments are coloured in the calendar.
settings.logo_sub: Shown in the sidebar, on the clinic page and on printed invoices and prescriptions.
settings.logo_help: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 1 MB. A square image works best.
settings.logo_too_big: The logo must be 1 MB or smaller.
settings.logo_invalid: Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
settings.account_lead: Your personal details. Other staff see your name on appointments, visits and the audit log.
settings.email_ro: Your sign-in e-mail. Ask a clinic manager if it needs to change.
settings.my_clinics_sub: Clinics you have access to with this account.
settings.pw_signout_note: Changing your password signs you out on your other devices.
settings.password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
settings.sessions_sub: Devices where your account is signed in right now.
settings.revoke_others_confirm: Sign out everywhere except this device?
settings.sessions_more: …and {n} more. "Sign out all other devices" ends them all.
settings.recent_activity_sub: Your last sign-ins and password changes.
settings.roles_lead: Built-in roles cover most clinics. Create a custom role when someone needs a different mix of access.
settings.custom_roles_sub: Roles you created for this clinic.
settings.custom_empty_text: For example a "Lab technician" who only sees patients and vital signs.
settings.matrix_sub: What every role can do. Owners always have every permission.
settings.insurance_lead: Insurance companies your clinic works with. Front desk picks one when a patient pays by insurance.
settings.insurance_name_ph: As printed on the insurance card
settings.coverage_help: Share of the fee the insurer pays (0–100%).
settings.insurance_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? Past invoices keep the company name.
settings.insurance_empty_text: Add the insurers you accept so reception can record insured visits.
settings.meds_lead: Doctors choose from this list when writing prescriptions (they can still type any medication).
settings.meds_empty_text: Start with a list of common medications and edit it, or add your own.
settings.data_lead: Your clinic's data belongs to you: see who changed what, export everything, or delete the clinic.
settings.export_sub: One Excel workbook with a sheet for each: patients, appointments, invoices, doctors, services and expenses.
settings.audit_sub: Every important change in this clinic, newest first.
settings.danger_sub: Irreversible actions. Only the clinic owner can do this.
settings.delete_clinic_text: Permanently deletes {name} with all its patients, appointments, invoices, staff access and settings. Export your data first.
settings.delete_clinic_confirm: This permanently deletes {name} and everything in it. It can't be undone.

clinic.appearance_updated: Changed the clinic colour or logo

datasync.completed: Copied data to the external database
datasync.failed: Copy to the external database failed

settings.desc_database: Copy the clinic data to your own MySQL or PostgreSQL database.
settings.desc_messaging: WhatsApp, SMS and e-mail confirmations, reminders and review requests.
settings.desc_signatures: Doctor signatures and the clinic stamp on documents
settings.desc_privacy: Who can open medical records, and the access log

team.lead: Everyone who signs in to your clinic — doctors, nurses, reception, accounting and management. Each person gets their own login and sees only what their role allows.
team.add_sub: Create a login for a doctor, nurse, receptionist, accountant or manager.
team.role_help: Decides what they can see and do. Details in Roles & permissions.
team.doctor_help: Required for the Doctor role: the login sees this doctor's own schedule and patients.
team.doctor_help_edit: A doctor login works on the linked doctor's schedule.
team.no_free_doctors: Every doctor profile already has a login.
team.email_help: They sign in with this e-mail.
team.method_password_text: Create the login now. You'll see a temporary password to hand over; they must change it at first sign-in.
team.method_invite_text: We e-mail them a link to set their own password (valid 7 days).
team.method_invite_noemail: E-mail isn't set up, so you'll get a link to send them yourself (e.g. by WhatsApp). Valid 7 days.
team.temp_password_note: Copy it now and hand it over privately. When they sign in, DocBook asks them to choose their own password.
team.or_login: (Staff sign-in) or on the DocBook sign-in page.
team.invite_sent_text: We e-mailed the invitation to {email}. You can also copy the link and send it yourself.
team.invite_manual_text: E-mail isn't set up on this server, so nothing was sent. Copy this link and send it to {name} — by WhatsApp, for example.
team.invite_valid: The link is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
team.added_existing_text: They already had a DocBook account (for example at another clinic), so they sign in with their existing password and will find your clinic in their clinic list.
team.reset_text: Send this link to {name}. It lets them choose a new password; their current password keeps working until they do.
team.reset_valid: Valid for 24 hours and can be used once. Generating a new link does not cancel this one.
team.reset_emailed_text: This person also works at another clinic, so the link was e-mailed to {email} instead of being shown here.
team.no_login_text: Give each doctor their own login so they can see their day, patients and write visit notes.
team.empty_group_text: Add a login for this part of your team.
team.disable_help: A disabled login can't sign in. Their history stays in the clinic.
team.reset_confirm: Generate a one-time password-reset link for {name}? You'll see the link once to send it to them.
team.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from this clinic? They lose access immediately. Their past appointments and notes stay.
team.pending_sub: Invitations that haven't been accepted yet.
team.revoke_confirm: Revoke the invitation for {email}? The link stops working.
team.how_sub: Share these steps with your team.
team.how_1_text: Create it here — with a temporary password or an invitation link.
team.how_2_text: Staff sign-in is on your clinic page:
team.how_2_noslug: Set your clinic page address in Clinic page & booking, or use the DocBook sign-in page.
team.how_3: Choose the role and sign in
team.how_3_text: Each role opens its own start page. First-time users with a temporary password choose their own password.
team.invite_mail_body: Hello {name}, {clinic} has invited you to DocBook as {role}. Open the link to set your password and join the clinic. The link is valid for 7 days.

onboarding.title: Set up your clinic
onboarding.skip_confirm: Skip the rest of the setup? You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.lead_clinic: The name and contact details patients will see.
onboarding.lead_region: So appointment times and prices are always right.
onboarding.lead_doctors: Each doctor gets a schedule for bookings. You can add details, photos and days off later.
onboarding.lead_services: What patients can book — a consultation, a follow-up, a cleaning…
onboarding.lead_team: Nurses, reception and doctors each get their own login and see only what they need. Optional — you can do this any time in Settings.
onboarding.lead_page: Patients book online at this address, and your team signs in from it too.
onboarding.name_en_help: Used when patients browse in English.
onboarding.region_note: Appointment slots, "today" on the dashboard and reminders all follow the clinic's time zone — not the device of whoever is signed in.
onboarding.add_doctor_sub: Name, fee and weekly hours are enough to start taking bookings.
onboarding.i_am_doctor_text: link this profile to my own account so I see my own day.
onboarding.add_service_sub: You can set a different price per doctor later.
onboarding.team_sub: Create a login now, or skip and do it later from Settings → Staff & logins.
onboarding.booking_on_text: patients choose a doctor, service and free time on your clinic page.
onboarding.page_note: You can change the address, turn booking off, and upload your logo any time in Settings.

errors_admin.RESET_NEEDS_EMAIL: This person also works at another clinic, so a reset link can only be e-mailed to them — and e-mail isn't set up on this server. Ask them to use "Forgot password" once e-mail is available, or to contact the other clinic.
